info.short_description: Geographic FIPS code as a string: 5-digit county code in census_county.parquet; 2-digit state code or '00' (national) in census_state.parquet. Includes Puerto Rico (72) and its municipios.

Year-end date (YYYY-12-31) of the data vintage. Each Census program has its own: ACS 5-year 2019-2024 (each year is the end of a 5-year window), PEP 2023, SAIPE and SAHIE 2024, urban/rural allocation and OQM 2020.
Identifier of the measure in this row; the name matches the source column in the census standard file. All 90 census measures are present -- this bundle carries no allow-list.
Median age of the total population.

info.short_description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription.
info.long_description: Proportion of occupied housing units that have a broadband (high-speed) internet subscription, derived from ACS Table B28002. Includes cable, fiber, DSL, satellite, and fixed wireless connections.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have a broadband internet subscription.

info.short_description: Share of women aged 15–50 who gave birth in the past 12 months.
info.long_description: Proportion of women aged 15–50 years who gave birth in the past 12 months, derived from ACS Table B13002. Used as an approximation of the general fertility rate.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of women aged 15–50 gave birth in the past year.

info.long_name: Opportunity Youth Rate (Ages 16–24, Not in School or Work)
info.short_description: Share of youth aged 16–24 who are neither enrolled in school nor employed.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 16–24 who are not enrolled in school and not employed (sometimes called 'disconnected youth' or 'opportunity youth'), derived from ACS Table B14005.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of youth aged 16–24 are neither in school nor employed.

info.short_description: Ratio of dependents (ages 0–17 and 65+) to working-age adults (ages 18–64).
info.long_description: Ratio of the combined count of young (0–17 years) and older (65+) dependents to the working-age population (18–64 years), derived from ACS Table B01001. A higher ratio indicates a greater relative burden on the working-age population.
info.statement: In {location}, there are {value} dependents for every working-age adult.

info.long_name: Civilian Noninstitutionalized Population with a Disability Rate
info.short_description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with any disability.

info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population has a disability.

info.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have at least a high school diploma or equivalent.
info.long_description: Proportion of the population aged 25 and older who have completed high school (including equivalency), derived from ACS Table B15002. Includes all levels of educational attainment at or above high school.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have at least a high school diploma.

info.short_description: Share of adults aged 25+ who have attended any college or higher.

info.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults aged 25+ have attended college or obtained a higher degree.

info.short_description: Measure of household income inequality (0=perfect equality, 1=maximum inequality).
info.long_description: The Gini index measures the degree of income inequality among households, derived from ACS Table B19083. A value of 0 represents perfect equality; 1 represents maximum inequality. The ACS Gini is based on household income.
info.statement: In {location}, the Gini index of income inequality is {value}.

info.short_description: Share of the total population living in group quarters (prisons, dorms, nursing homes, etc.).

info.long_name: Severe Housing Cost Burden Rate (Spending 50%+ of Income on Housing)

info.short_description: Share of family households headed by a single parent with children.

info.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so measures the Census Bureau could not estimate for small populations have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Rates and shares are proportions on a 0-1 scale, with these exceptions: `acs_OWS` is an unbounded S80/S20 ratio, `acs_DEP` is a dependency ratio, `acs_GNI` and `acs_REX` are 0-1 index values, `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_POP*`/`pep_population` are person counts, and `acs_INB`, `acs_INC`, `acs_PCI`, `acs_VAL` and `saipe_median_household_income` are nominal dollars, not inflation-adjusted. The five income-quintile shares (`acs_INL` through `acs_INP`) sum to 1 within a geography-year; `acs_INQ` is the top-5% share and is a subset of the highest quintile, not a sixth additive category.

info.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so measures the Census Bureau could not estimate for small populations have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Rates and shares are proportions on a 0-1 scale, with these exceptions: `acs_OWS` is an unbounded S80/S20 ratio, `acs_DEP` is a dependency ratio, `acs_GNI` and `acs_REX` are 0-1 index values, `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_POP*`/`pep_population` are person counts, and `acs_INB`, `acs_INC`, `acs_PCI`, `acs_VAL` and `saipe_median_household_income` are nominal dollars, not inflation-adjusted. The five income-quintile shares (`acs_INL` through `acs_INP`) sum to 1 within a geography-year; `acs_INQ` is the top-5% share and is a subset of the highest quintile, not a sixth additive category.

bundle_census/dist/census_county.parquet.long_name: Value of the census measure identified by measure
bundle_census/dist/census_county.parquet.short_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file. Units vary by measure; see the corresponding level.
bundle_census/dist/census_county.parquet.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so measures the Census Bureau could not estimate for small populations have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Rates and shares are proportions on a 0-1 scale, with these exceptions: `acs_OWS` is an unbounded S80/S20 ratio, `acs_DEP` is a dependency ratio, `acs_GNI` and `acs_REX` are 0-1 index values, `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_POP*`/`pep_population` are person counts, and `acs_INB`, `acs_INC`, `acs_PCI`, `acs_VAL` and `saipe_median_household_income` are nominal dollars, not inflation-adjusted. The five income-quintile shares (`acs_INL` through `acs_INP`) sum to 1 within a geography-year; `acs_INQ` is the top-5% share and is a subset of the highest quintile, not a sixth additive category.
